创作室，《壮志凌云》的剧本改编进入了尾声。但与此同时，最大的争议也来了。
两个谈恋爱的年轻人，要不要在打下敌机后亲吻，哪怕只是亲吻脸颊。
韩静亭觉得两人拥抱一下就已经是大尺度了，坚决不能亲吻，亲吻的尺度太大了。
在《壮志凌云》的改编之初，对于爱情这条线就没有进行弱化处理。
十几分钟后，沈河拎着包进了健身房，面不红气不喘的，昨天的加点算是立了大功。
但这东西，毕竟是天子剑，而且是李氏族长的信物，所以不得不彻查。
但是，那名白衣少年刚才的言语，却是清晰地传入了他们所有人的脑海之中。
长孙无忌、魏征都没太看明白，候莫陈辉拿了两支长枪，张思政手里是一面长盾。
“三千多万的点击？好厉害！”刘艺菲印象里百万点击的视频就已经很高了，上千万的还真没见过。
谢老夫人想说些什么，但谢玉睿已经拉着陈云棠离开，连个眼神都没给她。

In the creative studio, the script adaptation of "Top Gun" is coming to an end. But at the same time, the biggest controversy also came.
Two young people in love should kiss after shooting down an enemy plane, even if it's just a kiss on the cheek.
Han Jingting felt that a hug between the two of them was already too large, and they must not kiss because the kiss was too big.
At the beginning of the adaptation of "Top Gun", the love line was not weakened.
Ten minutes later, Shen He entered the gym with his bag in hand. His face was not red and he was out of breath. Yesterday's extra points were considered a great achievement.
But this thing is the Emperor's Sword after all, and it is the token of the Li clan leader, so it has to be investigated thoroughly.
However, the words of the young man in white were clearly transmitted into the minds of all of them.
Changsun Wuji and Wei Zheng didn't quite understand. Hou Mo Chen Hui had two spears, and Zhang Sizheng had a long shield in his hand.
"More than 30 million clicks? That's amazing!" Liu Yifei thought that a video with one million clicks was already very high, and she had never seen a video with tens of millions of clicks.
Mrs. Xie wanted to say something, but Xie Yurui had already pulled Chen Yuntang away without even giving her a look.
